scope: ART-S1/S2/S3 + ART-S4 full 110-day content production jobs

rules.originality: Create original game art. Public references inform only generic information hierarchy, readability, camera/perspective and category conventions.
rules.execution: Anchor review precedes family-scale production. Output is not APPROVED until every acceptance gate is recorded.
rules.naming: Final export filename uses formal AssetId.
negative: match-3 board, swap puzzle, cascade puzzle, match lines
cats, dogs, unrelated mascots or unrelated human characters
readable Chinese text, readable English text, logo, slogan, store name, fake asset label
unrequested foods, props, buildings or characters not named by the current job
poster layout or collage when the job requests one isolated runtime asset
hardConstraints: Merge board is always 9 columns x 7 rows; do not depict Match-3 mechanics.
Only render subjects explicitly named by the job.
Production images contain no readable text or branding.
Character species and fixed props must match character_canon_v4.
Transparent asset jobs are isolated objects, not style-guide posters.
